Paper is the strongest candidate for the editorial goal; Notebook is a credible, materially different challenger. This is a research recommendation, not a final product decision. No product code was changed.

| Candidate | Actually observed | Adoption implication |
|---|---|---|
| **Vanilla Paper 0.10.0** | Warm desk and cream sheet, fine red margin rule, serif reading/headings, sans navigation, ruled monospace editing. Night preserves its warm surface hierarchy. | Strongest identity across populated reading and editing; requires more vertical scrolling. |
| **Notebook 1.4.1** | Centered sans sheet, compact editor, persistent search/utility topbar and mobile bottom bar; slate dark palette with orange tags. | Denser reading and editing with persistent utilities; less distinction between reading and editing. |
| **Vendored Starlight** | Source supplies global Arvo/Times and bitmap texture over Snow White; its comment describes a placeholder refinement. | Weaker whole-workspace candidate. Source-inspected only, not visually compared by this child. |

Both external original demos were rendered and personally viewed, separately from populated trials using the supplied TiddlyWiki 5.4.1.

Sources and rights:

- **Paper:** https://github.com/BurningTreeC/vanilla-paper — revision `031a78d4d4187128c632f8a647fa05408eddc700`, MIT, Simon Huber 2026. Demo: https://burningtreec.github.io/vanilla-paper/.
- **Notebook:** https://github.com/NicolasPetton/Notebook — revision `465c832c885894ee3c97be76449cc524e1252eb0`, MIT, Nicolas Petton 2020. Demo: https://saqimtiaz.github.io/sq-tw/notebook.html.
- Exact archives, complete source, licenses, file hashes and resolved revisions are retained in `evidence/research/`. `SOURCES.json` records their identities; Paper’s plugin Git blob hash matches the commit API response.

Paper supplies a complete workspace theme. Install its complete theme directory, select `$:/themes/BurningTreeC/vanilla-paper`, and use its `VanillaPaperDay`/`VanillaPaperNight` palettes. Preserve its numbered stylesheet order, serif/sans/mono roles, margin proportions and ruled-editor rhythm. It is standalone and includes compatibility shims for core/plugin references to Vanilla metrics.

Notebook needs Vanilla loaded, its theme and notebook-mobile plugin. Its centered sheets and top/mobile navigation composition—not merely its palette—carry the challenger’s value.

Final corrected comparison is retained in `commands/013/` with runnable `capture-trials.py`. Representative personally viewed captures include:

- `paper-v5-editor-day.png`
- `paper-v5-390-night.png`
- `notebook-v5-1440-day.png`
- `notebook-v5-interview-night.png`
- `notebook-v5-390-night.png`

Original demos are `paper-original-demo-1440.png` and `notebook-original-demo-1440.png`. Actual image-view responses are retained in `view-*.json`.

Trials covered 1440×900, 1280×640 and 390×844 at DPR1 with Chromium143 and the supplied CJK fixture. Native edit/cancel were operated; disappearance of the editor after cancellation was asserted. Persistence and full task journeys remain the parent’s independent verification responsibility.

Important limits and findings:

- **Paper has an upstream reduced-motion conflict:** its layout requests 1ms transitions, but a later global surface rule imposes `150ms !important`. Computed page-container duration is **0.15s**. A narrow specificity repair can preserve its documented quiet-layout intent.
- Pencil controls and date metadata have low emphasis, especially at night; supported native toolbar visibility configuration deserves attention.
- Notebook’s fixed desktop topbar can cover a title after raw programmatic scrolling. Native navigation and focus behavior need their own check.
- Failed configuration attempts and intermediate transition/confirmation captures are retained and clearly distinguished from the corrected comparison.
- Static views were personally inspected. No natural-time playback was available, so there is no claim about smoothness, pacing, interruption quality or frame rate.
- Paper is newer and has published compatibility/testing caveats; these bounded trials do not establish broad accessibility, plugin compatibility or user preference.

Full report: `/workspace/scratch/dc68edd00fe1/ui-study/w11/evidence/research/REPORT.md`. Final delivery text and visual-review notes are saved alongside it.
